Ratio of net investment income to average net assets (4) | 10.70 | %

findings.detail: Stored distribution_rate is 19.6195%, but the 2025 financial highlights show total distributions of 8.60 per unit and ending NAV of 91.75, implying about 9.37%.

rationale: F16 compares distribution_rate to income_yield_pct * 1.5. The source reports the 2025 ratio of net investment income to average net assets as 10.70%, so the threshold is 16.05%. The same financial highlights report 2025 total distributions of 8.60 per unit and ending NAV of 91.75, implying a distribution rate of about 9.37%, not the observed 19.6195%. The flag is therefore grounded as a real data error localized to the stored distribution_rate rather than a valid high-distribution source fact.
